description: The balances the bank reports for one account uid: every type it sends (booked, available, interim, and so on), each with the PSD2 code as sent and its meaning spelled out, a reference date where the bank gives one, and the amount as an EXACT decimal string signed by the bank (negative when overdrawn). One read at the bank per call, like a statement.

account_uid.description: The uid field from list_accounts (a UUID, not the IBAN).

name: get_balances
title: Get balances
